data_description.device_type: Simple on/off device or device with variable power management

data.subscribe_to_events: Recalculate with every new Production/Consumption Value

data_description.refresh_period_sec: Even with no new data, refresh at least in with this period in seconds. Warning heavy calculations are done at each period, so keep an eye on the CPU load. Don't refresh to often
data_description.power_consumption_entity_id: The entity_id of the net power consumption sensor. Net power should be negative if power is exported to grid.
data_description.power_production_entity_id: The entity_id of the solar power production sensor.
data_description.subscribe_to_events: Subscribe to events to recalculate with new data, as soon as they are avalaible. Keep an eye on the CPU load.
data_description.sell_cost_entity_id: The entity_id which holds the current energy sell price.
data_description.buy_cost_entity_id: The entity_id which holds the current energy buy price.
data_description.sell_tax_percent_entity_id: The energy resell tax percent (0 to 100)
data_description.smooth_production: If checked, the net consumption (grid import/export) is averaged over a time window to avoid switching on short variations
data_description.battery_soc_entity_id: The entity id of the battery state of charge in %. If you don't have battery, keep it empty
data_description.battery_charge_power_entity_id: The entity id of the battery power net charging rate in watt. It should be negative if battery is charging and positive if battery is discharging. Keep it empty if no solar battery is used.
data_description.raz_time: Time to reset active time counters. Should be before first exposure to sunlight but not too early to allow enough time for night activation
data_description.smoothing_window_sec: Length of the moving average applied to the net consumption
data_description.algorithm: enumeration: exact economic optimisation with the supervisor (minimal times, confirmations, load shedding, invariants); annealing: the original algorithm
data_description.contracted_power_entity_id: Entity with the contracted power (kW or W). The import is kept under it minus the margin
data_description.contracted_power_margin_percent: The limit is the contracted power minus this percentage
data_description.offpeak_entity_id: Binary sensor on during the off-peak period (values per period and off-peak backup)
data_description.notify_service: e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone: manual changes (with a 'back to automatic' action), faulty devices, invariant violations
data_description.group_count: Groups of devices served in order of priority, each one with its share of the surplus
data_description.group_import_caps: Optional, e.g. 2:0.5 = group 2 never imports more than 0.5 kW
data_description.start_separation_sec: Two starts of any devices are at least this far apart
data_description.warmup_sec: After a restart nothing is commanded until this long of valid measures (load shedding excepted)
data_description.discard_after_command_sec: The surplus samples right after a command are not averaged (the measures are still moving)
data_description.foreign_user_ids: Comma-separated user ids: their changes are logged, not taken as manual changes (useful in dry run next to another controller)

data.name: Device name
data.max_on_time_offpeak_min: Max on time during off-peak hours
data.manual_end_at_reset: End the manual mode at the daily reset

data_description.name: The name of the device
data_description.power_max: The power of the device when activated. Can be a number or a template
data_description.check_usable_template: The template to check if the device is usable. Example `True ` or `states('sensor.my_sensor') | float > 10` (don't forgeet double accolades)
data_description.check_active_template: The template to check if the device is active. Keep it empty for switch type device or apparented. Example `is_state_attr('sensor.my_sensor', 'hvac_mode', 'heat')` (with double accolades)
data_description.duration_min: The minimum duration of the device when turned on in minutes
data_description.duration_stop_min: The minimum duration of the device when turned off in minutes
data_description.action_mode: The action mode of the device. `service` to service call a service to turn on or off or `event` to send an event to turn on or off
data_description.activation_service: The service to activate the device. Example `switch/turn_on` or `climate/set_hvac_mode/hvac_mode:cool`
data_description.deactivation_service: The service to deactivate the device. Example `switch/turn_off` or `climate/set_hvac_mode/hvac_mode:off`. Keep it empty if the device will turn off by itself
data_description.battery_soc_threshold: The battery state of charge threshold to activate the device. Can be a number or a template
data_description.max_on_time_per_day_min: The maximum time per day in state on in minutes. Can be a number or a template. If minium time is not reached during daylight, it will be activated during offpeak time until max time is reached
data_description.min_on_time_per_day_min: The minimum time per day in state on in minutes. Can be a number or a template. If minium time is not reached during daylight, it will be activated during offpeak time
data_description.max_on_time_offpeak_min: Maximum forced running time during off-peak hours in minutes. Defaults to the daily maximum and must be between the daily minimum and maximum.
data_description.offpeak_time: The offpeak time with format HH:MM
data_description.manual_detection: If checked, a change of the device (or of its power entity) not made by Solar Optimizer puts the device in manual mode: Solar Optimizer leaves it alone until the manual mode ends
data_description.manual_max_hours: The manual mode ends at the latest after this time, and always at the daily reset time
data_description.echo_window_sec: Changes seen during this time after a Solar Optimizer command are considered caused by it
data_description.manual_release_template: Optional template: when it renders true the manual mode ends (e.g. car unplugged)
data_description.group: Priority group of the device for the enumeration algorithm (1 = served first)
data_description.value: What 1 kWh delivered to this device is worth: between the selling price and the cheapest buying price. Initial value of the peak and off-peak value entities
data_description.measured_power_entity_id: Optional sensor with the power really drawn by the device (W)
data_description.confirm_on_min: The plan must ask for the start this long without interruption before the device is started
data_description.confirm_off_min: The plan must ask for the stop this long without interruption before the device is stopped
data_description.max_starts_per_hour: Starts of the device in any 60 min window
data_description.shed_reaction_sec: Time to wait after shedding this device before the next shedding step
data_description.verify_after_sec: The state is read back this long after a command; up to 3 retries, then the device is marked faulty
data_description.not_absorbing_w: Optional: on with a level but drawing less than this for 2.5 min -> left out for 30 min (e.g. full car)
data_description.manual_ignore_template: Optional template: changes seen while it renders true are made by the device itself, not manual (e.g. a charger that starts when plugged)
data_description.manual_end_at_reset: If unchecked, the manual mode only ends with the maximal duration, the release template or the back-to-automatic button (e.g. an air conditioner switched on at night is not switched off at the reset time)
